notice.dismiss: Don’t remind me about this version

status.ready: Version {{version}} is ready: it installs when you restart (or the next time you quit Aula).

available.translocated: A new version is out ({{version}}). For Aula to update itself, move it to the Applications folder and open it from there.
available.readOnly: A new version is out ({{version}}), but Aula can’t write to the folder it’s in. To let it update itself, move it to a folder you can write to, or ask whoever manages this computer to install the new version.
available.failedBefore: Version {{version}} couldn’t install itself. Download it from the website or try again.
available.package: A new version is out ({{version}}). Since you installed Aula from a package (.deb), it doesn’t update itself: download the new package and install it the same way as the first one.

error.offline: No connection: couldn’t check right now. Aula will try again later.
error.unavailable: No published version was found to download. Aula will try again later.
error.corrupt: The download of version {{version}} arrived damaged and was discarded. Your version is unchanged.
error.signature: Aula couldn’t confirm that version {{version}} is genuine, so it didn’t install it. Your version is unchanged. Don’t download it by hand unless the project announces it.
error.permission: Aula isn’t allowed to update itself in this folder. Download the new version and install it by hand.
error.disk: There’s no disk space left for the new version. Free up some space and check again.
error.install: Version {{version}} couldn’t be installed. You’re still on {{current}}, which works as always.
error.unknown: Couldn’t update right now. Aula will try again later.
error.offlineDownload: The connection dropped while downloading version {{version}}. Aula will try again later.
error.system: Version {{version}} needs a newer version of macOS than this Mac has, so it wasn’t installed. You’re still on {{current}}.

unsupported.dev: This is a development copy: it doesn’t update itself.
unsupported.package: This copy of Aula doesn’t update itself. New versions are on the project’s website.
